name: gorilla-bench-apis
description: A dataset of API-related prompts and expected outputs designed to evaluate a model's ability to generate correct API calls, handle API-based tasks, and produce executable request payloads. It focuses on functional correctness of API call generation and instruction-following in agentic interactions.
evaluation_method: exact_match (functional correctness of generated API requests)
reputation: Used by practitioners and developers evaluating agent/LLM integration with APIs; modest academic visibility but practical relevance for system builders.
